mapper.select: SELECT pv.visitor_uid AS visitorUid, u.username, u.avatar, u.gender, u.age, u.job, pv.visit_count AS visitCount, pv.total_duration AS totalDuration, pv.interest_level AS interestLevel, pv.last_visit_time AS lastVisitTime, u.vip FROM profile_visit pv LEFT JOIN user u ON pv.visitor_uid = u.uid WHERE pv.target_uid = #{targetUid} AND u.status = 0 ORDER BY pv.last_visit_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT pv.visitor_uid AS visitorUid, u.username, u.avatar, u.gender, u.age, u.job, pv.visit_count AS visitCount, pv.total_duration AS totalDuration, pv.interest_level AS interestLevel, pv.last_visit_time AS lastVisitTime, u.vip FROM profile_visit pv LEFT JOIN user u ON pv.visitor_uid = u.uid WHERE pv.target_uid = #{targetUid} AND pv.interest_level >= 2 AND u.status = 0 ORDER BY pv.interest_level DESC, pv.last_visit_time DESC
